thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: autoscaler failed to add GPU nodes in asia-south1 for service: text-gen-prod. queue_depth=1248, failures=237 in last 5m, reason=QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Paging @alex (sre-oncall) and @maria.

alex: I'm on it. confirming which quota triggered it (GPUs or regional instance count).

maria: looks like GPU quota on our org account for asia-south1 is at 100/100. recent autoscale attempts show HTTP 403 from GCP with message 'quotaExceeded'.

sriram: impact: all text-gen v2 requests are queuing. latency p95 spiking >8s and many timeouts. CS reports customers seeing errors for generation-heavy endpoints.

jess: getting multiple incoming CCs. One AE reported a customer hitting production errors and failing over isn't automatic for them.

alex: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle non-critical routes (batch jobs + evals) 2) route traffic for key customers to fallback region eu-west1 where capacity exists 3) spin up smaller non-GPU fallback (cpu-quantized) for low-priority requests.

lee: adding routing rule now: /embeddings and /batch-gen -> reduce to 20% of previous qps. will push policy in 30s.

maria: hitting account limit for GPUs. I can open quota increase request with GCP but that takes hours. contacting cloud-sales for expedited path.

cloud-sales: raised support case 1234567 with GCP, marked Sev2 and requested quota bump. CC'd our TAM. ETA unknown but asked for immediate manual approval.

sriram: can we de-prioritize internal ML eval traffic? those are big batched jobs.

alex: yes. disabling scheduled evals and pausing CI-triggered runs now.

incident-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-gpu-quota

alex: also starting manual node eviction of long-running spot jobs to free up slots for inference-pools. Maria, do we have spare preemptible pools in asia-south1? We might be able to get temporary capacity.

maria: we have 8 preemptible GPUs free but autoscaler won't use preemptible by default due to policy. I can manually provision a small pool and add to autoscaler group.

alex: do it. create pool named temp-asia-south1-gpu-1 with 8 V100s, attach to inference cluster, weight it for critical routing only.

maria: done. manual attach in progress. logs:
```
$ gcloud compute instances create gpu-temp-1 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-v100,count=1 --zone=asia-south1-a
Request processed: operation-12345 (status: DONE)
```

sriram: traffic routing to eu-west1 started. Expect reduced error rate for customers routed there, but some will see increased latency. Communicating to CS.

jess: letting customers know — pushing update to affected customers and status page. CS will mark affected customers in case-by-case for credits.

lee: adding a temporary routing fallback: if queue_time > 3s, failover to eu-west1. Pushed to edge config.

alex: monitoring queue. queue_depth dropped from 1248 -> 430 after throttles and preemptible nodes, errors down from 12%->3% in 20m. still unstable.

maria: GCP responded to case: they can do a manual quota increase of +32 GPUs within 2-3 hours if we provide justification. They requested a security contact and billing confirmation.

cloud-sales: provided requested info. asked for manual uplift and temporary quota to be applied to project id: redwood-prod-asia.

sriram: long-term mitigation: need fallback model variants with lower GPU memory, faster quantization fallback, and smarter autoscaler that can spin up cross-region in emergencies.

alex: Agree. For now keep throttles until quota bump completes. Also enable graceful degradation policy to return contextual 429s for low-priority customers instead of letting queue grow.

incident-bot: ACTIONS: alex->lead the incident, maria->manage quota & provisioning, sriram->routing + model fallbacks, jess->customer comms, lee->edge routing changes, cloud-sales->escalation to GCP.

jess: sent initial customer note. will send follow-up in 30m with ETA.

alex: on-call handoff note: @alex handing to @maria at 23:00 UTC for monitoring while I sleep. Maria, please escalate to oncall if errors rise >5% for 10m.

maria: acknowledged. will monitor and escalate. leaving detailed checklist in the channel.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by alex. Handoff scheduled at 23:00 UTC to maria.

sriram: quick note — adjusted model routing so the largest models (>24GB) are only used in eu-west1. in asia-south1 we now serve 8GB-12GB variants.

alex: good. will run postmortem tomorrow. preliminary severity: Sev2, customer impact moderate for ~1.5h, partial mitigations in place. add timeline and root-cause: quota exhausted + autoscaler not configured to failover cross-region.

maria: GCP confirmed manual uplift applied at 22:45 UTC +32 GPUs. autoscaler back to normal scaling within 6 minutes.

sriram: queue drained fully by 22:52 UTC, error rates back to baseline.

jess: customers updated. closing the loop with affected accounts.

alex: official postmortem assigned to me. tagging @lee and @sriram. Will include recommendations: proactive quota ownership for critical regions, autoscaler cross-region failover, lower-priority throttles by default, pre-warmed preemptible pools.

incident-bot: Incident status: RESOLVED. root_cause: Region GPU quota exhaustion in asia-south1, contributing: autoscaler lacked cross-region fallback, slow quota increase process. mitigation: manual preemptible pool, traffic throttles, routing to eu-west1, GCP manual uplift.
